Age of Titans is a PvP / Open World Kaiju game on Roblox that brings legendary monsters to life.

• Battle as iconic kaiju
• Unlock skins to customize your appearance
• Explore the world and fight other players
• Master unique abilities and ultimates

Completely Free to Play

If you enjoy the experience, make sure to like 👍 and favorite ⭐ for future updates!

🎮 Controls

PC
• Abilities: 1–5
• Ultimate: V
• Light Combo: Mouse1
• Block: F
• Roars: R / T
• Sprint: Shift
• Auto Run: Z
• Control Lock: Ctrl

Controller
• Abilities: A / B / X / Y
• Ultimate: R1
• Light Combo: R2
• Block: L2 (Hold)
• Roars: D-Pad Right / Left
• Sprint: L3
• Control Lock: D-Pad Up
